messages:
Nora: Hey, quick onboarding snag. I followed the onboarding doc but the 'Team Templates' folder is missing from my sidebar. Anyone else hit that?
Devex Bot: Sometimes sidebar sync lags. Try: Settings & Members > My Account > Sync sidebar, or open the Team Templates link directly: https://redwood.notion.so/devex-team-templates. If it still doesn't show, request doc access with `/doc-access request <url>`.
Nora: Sidebar still blank. I can view Team Templates but can't duplicate (button disabled).
Eli: That usually means you're in view-only group. @Priya can you check group membership? Priya, can you add Nora to Product Editors?
Priya Rao: Added Nora to Product Editors. Nora, refresh Notion and you should be able to duplicate.
Nora: Works now, thanks! One more Q: should I put recurring meeting notes into the Team space or my personal space?
Devex Bot: If meeting notes are team-facing and will be referenced by others, put them in the Team space and tag Team Notes. If they're personal action items, keep them in personal space and link the team page.
Nora: Got it, thanks!
Priya Rao: Also, when duplicating templates, keep metadata properties intact. We rely on Owner + Status for audits.
Nora: Thanks everyone :blush:
